exactProductIdentificationRank1.note: Exact identity requires an explicit adapter classification of exact; probable-exact is not upgraded.

resultLevel.note: Safety among displayed offers only. Abstained queries are excluded here and counted as missed fulfillment in queryLevel.

queryLevel.note: A query with known eligible fixture offers counts only when an eligible offer is returned; abstention is not successful fulfillment.

falseExactMatchRate.note: Only explicitly classified exact offers among presented results. This tiny controlled-fixture denominator cannot establish a production false-exact rate.

identifierAccuracy.note: Diagnostic controlled-fixture measure; no separate identifier-accuracy threshold is defined in the blueprint scorecard.

providerErrorNoMatchDistinction.note: Sentinel provider failure must be PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE/retrieval_failure; each finite-snapshot no-match must remain NO_CONFIDENT_MATCH/no_match.

fixtureHarnessLatencyMs.note: Measured end-to-end around the local Phase 1 wrapper plus in-memory fixture adapter, not production server latency.

exactProductIdentificationRank1.note: Exact identity requires an explicit adapter classification of exact; probable-exact is not upgraded.

resultLevel.note: Safety among displayed offers only. Abstained queries are excluded here and counted as missed fulfillment in queryLevel.

queryLevel.note: A query with known eligible fixture offers counts only when an eligible offer is returned; abstention is not successful fulfillment.

falseExactMatchRate.note: Only independently gold-labeled identity cases are scored. Unannotated exact assertions are reported separately, not assumed false or true. This controlled sample cannot establish a production rate.

identifierAccuracy.note: Diagnostic controlled-fixture measure; no separate identifier-accuracy threshold is defined in the blueprint scorecard.

providerErrorNoMatchDistinction.note: Sentinel provider failure must be PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE/retrieval_failure; each finite-snapshot no-match must remain NO_CONFIDENT_MATCH/no_match.

fixtureHarnessLatencyMs.note: Measured end-to-end around the local Phase 1 wrapper plus in-memory fixture adapter, not production server latency.
